# Will this container take down its whole node?

> Paste Kubernetes manifests to find containers missing memory limits, CPU requests or ephemeral-storage limits that let one pod starve a node. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
